messages:
Devon: Huge shoutout to @Tina and @Raj for pulling an all-hands fix last night — customer was back in < 20m. Seriously saved my Monday :raised_hands:
Tina: oh wow, thanks! had to patch the routing table and nudge the fallback policy — team effort :muscle:
Raj: happy it worked, Devon — thanks for coordinating with support. big props to @Sasha too for grabbing coffee for the on-call crew at 2am :coffee:
Sasha: LOL that coffee was life. also, shoutout to @Liam who stayed to help validate the rollback plan. we nailed the postmortem notes this morning.
Maya (kudos-bot): :tada: Devon gave a kudos to Tina (2 points) and Raj (3 points) — congrats! Check your kudos leaderboard: https://kudos.redwood/company/leaderboard
Liam: appreciate the mention. team worked great under pressure — would like to nominate Tina for the on-call MVP this week :star2:
Tina: thanks everyone — felt calm with such a solid playbook. reminded me we should add a short checklist for routing fixes to the runbook.
Devon: yes please. I'll start a PR with a 5-step checklist and ping on #eng-oncall for review.
Raj: also, tiny celebratory gif: https://giphy.com/gifs/success-teamwork-3o6Zt6ML6BklcajjsA
Maya (kudos-bot): Reminder: monthly kudos raffle on Friday — every kudos this week counts as an entry :four_leaf_clover:
